title: Best Way to See Barcelona in 3 Hours
text: The tour lasted about two and a half hours. We visited the Sagrada Família, Casa Milà, Casa Batlló, El Born the beach of Barceloneta, and another park. My tour guide, Agatha, was amazing and explained the details of every place we visited. Before this tour, I was not confident of riding a bike besides cars in a city. During this tour, I felt confident and the best part is that you see a lot of streets and places in a short time.
author: 165shadyr

title: Do this!
text: Aleix was fantastic! He’s a passionate advocate for Catalunya and obviously loves sharing the history and beauty of his city. The bikes were easy and the route was very safe. Aleix was attentive to the group of eight ensuring that everyone made it through the lights… Excellent way to see different areas of Barcelona.
